body:
## Review result — `sniff-css` v2 snapshot/check contract

Verified against capture (`crates/sniff-css/src/commands/capture.rs:230-297`), matrix serialization (`crates/sniff-engine/src/output.rs:609-618, 934-960`), `MatrixTag` (`crates/sniff-core/src/modern.rs:302-322`), the dispatcher (`crates/sniff-css-check/src/modern/mod.rs:426-455`), docs and tests. Prioritized findings below; no files edited, no builds/tests run.

---

### HIGH — `--json` envelope omits the two documented v2 payloads
**Location:** `crates/sniff-css/src/commands/check.rs:231-237` (builds `data` with only `uniformity_instances`, `uniformity_outliers`, `rules`, `modern`, `dom_stats`); `crates/sniff-css/src/output.rs:135-140, 181-190` (envelope uses `output.data` only).
**Contract:** `docs/cli-surface.md:57-60` — "`data.checks` — linhas de `sniff check`, cada uma com `class` …"; "`__check_summary` dentro de `data` ganha `modern: N` e `opportunities_by_class`". `docs/modernization/02-arquitetura-alvo.md:130` repeats `data.checks`.
**Trigger/repro:** `sniff check snap.jsonl --json` → `data` has neither `checks` nor `__check_summary`; the summary exists only in the human text buffer (`check.rs:212-230`), which `--json` discards. Batch mode (`check.rs:63-72`) inherits the same `data`.
**Impact:** every machine consumer of the v2 contract (CI, MCP-adjacent tooling) cannot read `class`/`guide`/`evidence` or the summary via `--json`, despite the documented additive guarantee.
**Minimal fix:** build the check lines once, put them in `data.checks`, and put the same `__check_summary` object in both `data` and `buf`.

---

### HIGH — matrix-only evidence path of `reduced-motion-guard-missing` is dead in the CLI
**Location:** `crates/sniff-css/src/commands/check.rs:197-199` → `crates/sniff-css-check/src/modern/mod.rs:431-444` → `crates/sniff-css-check/src/modern/preferences.rs:288-306` (specifically line 292: `ctx.has_facet(Facet::Matrix)`).
**Trigger:** `__env` reports `no-preference` (the first state's default) but `__meta.matrix` contains a `prefers-reduced-motion=reduce` state, and `__declared` is absent or truncated. `basic_document` clears `matrix` (`check.rs:117`), so `baseline_ctx.has_facet(Facet::Matrix)` is always false → `via_matrix=false`.
**Impact:** the check silently skips in real `sniff check` runs. The unit test `preferences.rs:1251-1285` passes only because it calls the family directly with a matrix-bearing doc, bypassing `run_modern_checks_for`.
**Minimal fix:** run this one check with a ctx built from `full` (e.g. add a `full_ctx` parameter to `preferences::run` or a dedicated `run_with_full`), and add a dispatcher-level regression test.

---

### HIGH/MEDIUM — `baseline_document` no-ops when matrix tags lack node-id ranges → duplicated findings
**Location:** `crates/sniff-css/src/commands/check.rs:110-113`.
**Trigger:** any schema-2 snapshot whose `__meta.matrix` tags omit `node_id_start`/`node_id_end` — those fields are `#[serde(default)]` (`crates/sniff-core/src/modern.rs:317,320`), i.e. they postdate v2 and older/promoted/hand-built snapshots lack them. Returning `doc.clone()` keeps every state's nodes.
**Impact:** rules, uniformity and all non-comparative modern checks repeat the same finding once per state — exactly the regression this feature was meant to fix. Violates `SKILL.md:45` ("Node checks | first matrix state only"). `crates/sniff-css/tests/check_cli.rs:166` only covers the with-ranges case, so this is untested.
**Minimal fix:** when ranges are absent, fall back to positional decomposition (`roots[..roots.len()/states]`), mirroring `responsive::build_states` (`responsive.rs:113-155`); never return the full doc when `matrix.len() > 1`.

---

### HIGH/MEDIUM — empty matrix state re-bases IDs into the first state; `baseline_document` then keeps other states
**Location:** root cause `crates/sniff-css/src/commands/capture.rs:258-267` + `rebase_ids` at `:287-296`; manifests at `crates/sniff-css/src/commands/check.rs:114-116`.
**Trigger:** one state of the 3×4 matrix captures zero snapshots (selector matches nothing at that viewport/emulation, or content hidden). `rebase_ids` returns `largest=0` for an empty forest, so `offset = 0 + 1 = 1` instead of staying at `previous_max+1`. The next state is rebased from `1`, colliding with the first state's IDs (e.g. `1..100`), and its tag gets `node_id_start=1`.
**Impact:** `baseline_document` filters the first tag's range `[0,100]` and retains both the real first state **and** the collided later state → duplicated/lost findings and corrupted uniformity groups. `matrix` tags still look complete, so the `matrix_incomplete` warning (`check.rs:206`) stays silent; `responsive::build_states:140-150` finds `roots.len()` indivisible and skips all comparative checks with only a `tracing::warn` (no envelope warning).
**Minimal fix:** in `sniff_with_matrix`, only advance `offset` when `outcome.snapshots` is non-empty (`offset = last.max(node_id_start).saturating_add(1)`); additionally warn when any state has zero roots and include that in `matrix_incomplete`.

---

### MEDIUM — `--uniform` suppresses bug rules, contradicting the documented no-op
**Location:** `crates/sniff-css/src/commands/check.rs:133`; CLI flag `crates/sniff-css/src/cli/check.rs:26-29`.
**Contract:** `docs/diff-checks.md:75` — "`--uniform` | mantido por compatibilidade; a detecção de outlier já roda no default"; v2 flag table in `docs/modernization/08-contrato-v2.md:58-64` has no `--uniform` row. `README.md:74` recommends `sniff check snap.jsonl --uniform --tolerance 0.5`.
**Trigger/repro:** `sniff check snap.jsonl --uniform` → `run_rules = false||(!true && !false) = false`; rules disappear. No test covers this flag.
**Impact:** users following the README get uniformity + modern but no bug rules, silently; a compatibility flag changes the default family set.
**Minimal fix:** make `--uniform` a no-op for family selection — `let run_rules = args.rules || !args.modern;` (keep `--rules`/`--modern` semantics), and add a CLI test asserting rules still run with `--uniform`.

---

### MEDIUM — `opportunities_by_class` has the wrong shape
**Location:** `crates/sniff-css/src/commands/check.rs:222-224` emits `{"opportunity": modern_count}`.
**Contract:** `docs/diff-checks.md:84` — "contagem por classe de observabilidade `D`/`F`/`N`/`E`"; sample at `:173` — `{"D":1,"F":2,"N":1,"E":0}`. `CHANGELOG.md:31` promises it in MCP too; MCP's own summary (`crates/sniff-css-mcp/src/server.rs:1036-1042`) omits it entirely.
**Impact:** consumers reading `.opportunities_by_class.D/F/N/E` get `null`; the key `opportunity` is a `class` value, not an observability class.
**Minimal fix:** map each emitted `CheckLine` to its observability class (from its `CheckSpec`/guide metadata) and emit all four counters (zeros included); or, if the feature was dropped, remove the placeholder and amend the docs — do not leave both disagreeing.

---

### MEDIUM — `matrix_incomplete` warning checks tag count only, not state node counts
**Location:** `crates/sniff-css/src/commands/check.rs:206` and `:240-244`; contrast with `crates/sniff-css-check/src/modern/responsive.rs:118-150`.
**Trigger:** tags are all present (`total == len`) but one state yielded zero/different root counts, or a tag's `total` is understated. `build_states` then either skips all comparative checks (`roots.len() % observed != 0`) or mis-splits roots when counts differ but divide evenly.
**Impact:** the envelope warning never fires while "comparative checks skipped" is precisely what happened (or, worse, wrong state groupings produce false `breakpoint-jump`/overflow findings). `docs/cli-surface.md:59-61` promises the warning for matrix captures.
**Minimal fix:** warn when `doc.nodes.len() % doc.matrix.len() != 0`, when any tag `total != len`, and when node-id ranges do not partition the forest into complete states.

---

### MEDIUM/LOW — flag combinations can run zero families
**Location:** `crates/sniff-css/src/commands/check.rs:132-134`; `crates/sniff-css/src/cli/check.rs:31-44` (no `conflicts_with` on `rules`/`modern`; only `no_modern` conflicts with `modern`).
**Trigger/repro:** `sniff check snap.jsonl --rules --modern` → `run_uniform=false`, `run_rules=true`, `run_modern=false` (only rules, modern silently dropped). Through `--params`/`--batch` there is no clap conflict validation (`crates/sniff-css/src/input.rs:76-95`), so `{"modern":true,"no_modern":true}` yields all three booleans false → output is just the zeroed summary line.
**Impact:** contradictory flag sets produce a silently incomplete report instead of an error or both families.
**Minimal fix:** declare `conflicts_with` on `rules`↔`modern`, validate the merged struct in `compute`, and make `run_modern = args.modern || (!args.rules && !args.no_modern)`.

---

### LOW — schema promotion discards otherwise-valid v2 facets
**Location:** `crates/sniff-css-diff/src/model.rs:280-283, 303-315`.
**Trigger:** `__meta.schema` missing or typed wrong (`"2"`, `2.0`, value > `u8`): `as_u64()/u8::try_from` fail, `raw_schema` stays `1`, and promotion clears `document`, `env`, `declared`, `matrix`, `shadow_roots` even when those facets parsed successfully.
**Impact:** a schema-2 snapshot with a malformed schema marker loses all comparative/context checks without any load error.
**Minimal fix:** promote only when `raw_schema == 1` **and** the v2 facets are absent; otherwise keep parsed facets and treat the schema marker as unknown.

---

### LOW — inconsistent overwrite policy across repeated `__meta` lines
**Location:** `crates/sniff-css-diff/src/model.rs:275-279` (viewport keeps first), `:289` (`css_variables` keeps last), `:400` (`style_defaults` keeps last); `__actions` correctly accumulates at `:269-271`.
**Trigger:** a snapshot with per-state `__meta` lines carrying different `css_variables`/`style_defaults`.
**Impact:** earlier-state global data is lost while viewport is taken from the first state, so checks see a mixed context. The doc comment at `:229-233` claims "repeated facets keep the last successfully parsed value" — viewport violates that.
**Minimal fix:** apply one policy — extend/merge maps for `css_variables` and `style_defaults` (node-specific values still win), and document viewport as first-wins explicitly.

---

### LOW — `baseline_document` selects the first tag in wire order, not by `index`
**Location:** `crates/sniff-css/src/commands/check.rs:110` (`doc.matrix.first()`), while `responsive::build_states` sorts by `index` (`responsive.rs:128-136`).
**Trigger:** a matrix array whose tags are out of order (hand-built snapshots, reordered merges).
**Impact:** baseline may be taken from a non-first state, so node checks run on the wrong viewport/emulation while responsive checks use the sorted order.
**Minimal fix:** pick `doc.matrix.iter().min_by_key(|t| t.index)` for the baseline tag.

---

## Verified correct (no action)
- `--responsive` is default-**on** (`crates/sniff-css/src/cli/check.rs:57-60`: `default_value_t = true`, `serde(default = "default_true")`), and `responsive: args.responsive && !args.no_responsive` (`check.rs:93`) correctly honors `--no-responsive`. `ModernOptions::default()` also sets `responsive: true`.
- `run_modern_checks_for` correctly builds a `full` ctx only for `responsive::run` (`mod.rs:442-444`); dedup/sort (`mod.rs:449-455`) are sound given the registry's globally unique check ids, and `RuleStatus: Ord` gives `Pass<Warn<Fail`.
- v1→v2 promotion preserves `nodes`/`actions`/`viewport`/`css_variables` (`model.rs:303-315`) and tolerant parsing of malformed `__document`/`__env`/`__declared`/matrix tags does not abort the load (`model.rs:236-295`, `:342-348`).
- Modern checks never emit `Pass` lines, so `modern_count = lines.len()` (`check.rs:197`) equals the opportunity count.
